edge.quote: Herein, we present novel strategies for developing high-performance all-flexible QTCs using both metallized fibril-based textile electrodes with extremely large surface area, (specifically Ni textiles), and structure-breaking salts for hydrogel electrolytes.
context_quotes: The electrodes are oxidized to create Ni and Ni oxide heterostructures, forming numerous O vacancy defects that enhance redox reactions.
